# Z-Flow - Complete Business Information
# Operator-Engineering for Established SMBs | Automation, Custom Software & AI, built in Berlin

================================================================================
## COMPANY OVERVIEW
================================================================================

Z-Flow is the operator-engineer that established, profitable SMBs bring in when they have no internal automation or engineering talent — to find where they lose hours and money, then build the fix, from automation to production software, in weeks not quarters. One senior partner, backed by a vetted specialist network, so delivery never stalls. We diagnose like a consultant and ship like a senior engineer.

**Founder**: Mahmoud Sheikh Alard
**Location**: Berlin, Germany
**Markets served**: DACH (Germany, Austria, Switzerland) first; also NL, Benelux, Nordics, Ireland, UK; international (English-speaking)
**Company type**: Z-Flow UG (haftungsbeschränkt)
**Address**: Menzelstraße 3, 12157 Berlin, Germany

**Who we help**:
- Spearhead: established, profitable SMBs with no internal automation or engineering talent. Two tiers:
  - Tier 1 — software-literate service businesses (~10–50 people): digital/marketing agencies, e-commerce/DTC brands, recruiting/staffing firms, professional services. They move fast and convert quickly.
  - Tier 2 — German Mittelstand / industrial (up to ~300 people, profitable, not VC-funded): manufacturing, mobility/logistics, wholesale/distribution, construction/trades. Bigger, stickier engagements (see /digitalisierung).
- Secondary: small B2B SaaS — warm-referral only. They tend to DIY, so we don't cold-target them.
- Buyer: the owner / managing director / founder, or a Head of Digitalisierung / COO with a modernization mandate.

**How we start (the offer ladder)**:
1. Free 30-min diagnostic call — confirm the fit and one quick win. No obligation.
2. Operations Audit — €2,500, delivered in 5 business days, 50% credited toward your build. A paid diagnostic that maps your workflows and shows you exactly what to automate first — and what it's worth — producing a build-ready roadmap. Guarantee: your roadmap in 5 business days, or it's free.
3. Build — fixed-quoted from the roadmap (Quick Win → Sprint → Product/MVP).
4. Flow Partner retainer — ongoing development + monitoring.

**Core expertise**:
1. Automation with n8n, Make.com, and custom API integrations
2. Custom software / MVP development (Next.js, React, Supabase)
3. AI integration (Claude, OpenAI, RAG, MCP, custom LLM solutions)

================================================================================
## HOW WE START: THE OPERATIONS AUDIT
================================================================================

Most engagements begin with a paid diagnostic, not a guess. Charging to think first is what separates us from freelancers who jump straight to building.

**Free 30-min diagnostic call**: We confirm there's a real fit and one quick win worth chasing. No obligation.

**Operations Audit** — the wedge:
- **What it does**: we map your workflows and show you exactly what to automate first — and what it's worth.
- **Price**: €2,500 fixed. 50% credited toward any build within 60 days.
- **Timeline**: 5 business days. Roadmap in 5 business days or it's free.
- **Your time**: ~90 minutes (one discovery call + read-only access to 2–3 systems + a short async walkthrough).
- **Deliverable**: a 12–20 page build-ready roadmap — current-state workflow maps, a quantified time/€ leak table, a prioritized 90-day automation roadmap, and a build-ready spec of your #1 quick win — handed over on a 45-minute walkthrough call.

**Page**: https://z-flow.de/en/operations-audit

================================================================================
## SERVICES IN DETAIL
================================================================================

### 1. AUTOMATION — "Get your team's week back."

**What we offer**:
Automate the manual back-office and ops work — lead routing, CRM hygiene, reporting, hand-offs, invoicing, supplier and accounting integrations — that costs hours and causes errors. Built on n8n, Make, or custom APIs, whichever actually fits. Platform-agnostic: we recommend what works, not what we sell.

**Who it's for**:
- Established SMBs with manual processes and no internal automation/engineering talent
- Service businesses (agencies, e-commerce/DTC, recruiting/staffing, professional services) scaling on spreadsheets and copy-paste
- Mittelstand / industrial operations connecting multiple tools (ERP, billing, accounting, support, spreadsheets)
- Teams drowning in data entry, reporting, and hand-offs
- Organizations seeking GDPR-compliant automation (self-hosted n8n available)

**Platforms we use**:
- n8n (open-source, self-hostable for maximum privacy/GDPR compliance)
- Make.com (cloud, 1000+ integrations)
- Custom API integrations where off-the-shelf doesn't fit

**Proof**: Movacar — an established mobility company where we automated supplier integrations and end-to-end refunds into their accounting (Lexware). WeProspectify — ~3× more booked meetings/month and 20+ hours/week of manual work eliminated.

**Timeline**: 1–3 weeks
**Price**: from €6,000

**Keywords**: n8n agency, n8n developer, n8n Entwickler, n8n Agentur, Make.com expert, SMB automation agency, Mittelstand automation, back-office automation, workflow automation services, Prozessautomatisierung, GDPR compliant automation

---

### 2. MVP / CUSTOM SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT — "Ship the product you can't hire for."

**What we offer**:
Production software in 6 weeks, not 6 months. MVPs and internal tools good enough to win real users and clean enough to scale on. Same partner from first commit to production.

**Who it's for**:
- Established SMBs and founders who need to ship faster than they can hire
- Teams launching new products, customer portals, or internal tools
- Companies that have outgrown no-code and spreadsheets and need a scalable foundation

**Technology stack**:
- Next.js, React, TypeScript
- Supabase (database, auth, real-time)
- Tailwind CSS
- MCP for AI-extensible architecture
- Vercel deployment

**Proof**: WeProspectify — a scrappy Airtable + n8n MVP rebuilt into a scalable, AI-first product on Next.js with MCP, without ever taking the revenue engine offline. Working MVP in 8 weeks, full product in 12.

**Timeline**: 4–8 weeks depending on scope
**Price**: from €18,000 (fixed price, quoted from the Operations Audit roadmap)

**Keywords**: MVP development agency, MVP entwickeln lassen, custom software development, Softwareentwicklung Berlin, SMB internal tools, customer portal development, Next.js agency

---

### 3. AI INTEGRATION — "AI that does the work, not a demo."

**What we offer**:
Custom AI assistants, knowledge bases, and org-intelligence wired into your real stack — deployed only where it beats the alternative. Trained on your data, not generic.

**Technologies we work with**:
- Claude API (Anthropic)
- OpenAI API
- RAG pipelines + vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone)
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- n8n + AI workflows

**AI use cases we implement**:
- Custom AI assistants and chatbots trained on your data (SOPs, product docs, customer history)
- Company knowledge bases from internal documents
- Document intelligence (searchable knowledge from contracts, manuals, policies)
- Context-aware automation (ticket routing, classification, AI-assisted triage)
- AI voice agents for customer support

**Our AI principles**:
- Deployed only where it beats the alternative — not AI for its own sake
- Privacy-first: European or self-hosted solutions when needed
- Human-in-the-loop: AI supports, humans approve
- Trained on your data, not generic

**Company Brain** is our own AI organizational-intelligence platform — what we build for ourselves. It's a proof point and a lead-magnet (a 2-minute walkthrough/demo), not a headline product line. It connects to a team's tools and surfaces how work actually happens. Page: https://z-flow.de/en/company-brain

**Timeline**: 2–4 weeks
**Price**: from €5,000

**Keywords**: AI integration services, KI Integration, Claude API developer, OpenAI API integration, RAG system, AI chatbot development, MCP, AI for business, KI Assistent für Mitarbeiter, KI Wissensdatenbank

---

### 4. FLOW PARTNER — RETAINER / ONGOING PARTNERSHIP

**What we offer**:
Monthly development partnership for teams that need ongoing automation monitoring, feature development, and maintenance. Every build ends with live automations that need someone watching them — that's what the retainer covers.

**Tiers**:
- **Flow Lite** — €2,500/mo: 1 dev day + monitoring of all live automations
- **Flow Growth** (most popular) — €4,500/mo: 2 dev days + monitoring + monthly review
- **Flow Scale** — €7,500+/mo: 4 dev days + dedicated specialist + SLA + quarterly strategy

3-month minimum, then rolling.

## SECONDARY: DIGITALISIERUNG FOR THE MITTELSTAND
================================================================================

For established German Mittelstand and industrial SMEs drowning in Excel, email, and manual processes, we offer process digitization — diagnose, recommend the right tools (platform-agnostic), implement, and hand over. GDPR-compliant by default, on-site or remote. Entry process audit from €1,500.

**Page**: https://z-flow.de/de/digitalisierung

## PORTFOLIO / CASE STUDIES
================================================================================

### Movacar — established mobility company (CO-FLAGSHIP)
**Category**: Automation + AI | **Status**: Live
**Industry**: Mobility
**Why it matters**: Movacar is the established-SMB profile our ICP now targets — a profitable operator with no internal engineering team that needed a senior technical partner.
**Work**: We automated supplier integrations, built end-to-end refunds flowing into their accounting (Lexware), and shipped a support chatbot — then became their ongoing technical partner.

### WeProspectify — B2B sales prospecting platform (CO-FLAGSHIP)
**Category**: Automation → Custom Software | **Status**: Live
**Industry**: B2B SaaS · Sales
**Challenge**: A duct-taped Airtable + n8n prospecting setup that was also the live revenue engine — it worked barely, broke under load, and ate 20+ hours/week.
**Approach**: Stabilize before you rebuild. We stabilized the existing engine so revenue never stopped, then re-architected it underneath into a scalable, AI-first product on Next.js + Supabase with a clean schema, n8n orchestration across Smartlead/HeyReach/Airtable, and an MCP layer.
**Results**: ~3× more booked meetings/month, 20+ hours/week of manual prospecting eliminated, working MVP in 8 weeks and full product in 12.

### Galvany GmbH — German industrial company
**Category**: Digitalization | **Status**: Live
**Industry**: Industrial
**Work**: Process digitization for a German industrial business (DACH Mittelstand proof).

### Other selected work (established SMBs + Mittelstand)
- AI-powered marketing video generation (n8n + OpenAI + Ideogram): 50+ videos/week.
- AI voice agent for customer support (11Labs + n8n): 85% of inquiries handled without a human.
- End-to-end lead generation pipeline (n8n + Airtable + Smartlead + HeyReach).
- Automated invoicing (n8n + Airtable): 95% fewer invoice errors.
- Automated refund processing (Stripe + Lexware + Make.com): 30 seconds vs 15 minutes.
- Car-supplier data integration (Make.com + PostgreSQL): 500+ listings synced daily.
- Volunteer management platform (WeWeb + Xano): 80% faster onboarding.

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
================================================================================

**Q: What makes Z-Flow different from other agencies?**
A: We diagnose like a consultant and ship like a senior engineer. We start with a paid Operations Audit that quantifies where you lose hours and money, then build the fix. Platform-agnostic, transparent prices, real named clients with real numbers.

**Q: What is an Operations Audit?**
A: A paid diagnostic for established SMBs (€2,500, 5 business days). A senior operator-engineer maps your workflows and shows you exactly what to automate first — and what it's worth — then hands you a build-ready roadmap plus a spec of your #1 quick win. 50% of the fee is credited toward your build. Roadmap in 5 business days or it's free.

**Q: How does pricing work?**
A: Most engagements start with a free 30-min diagnostic, then a €2,500 Operations Audit. Builds are fixed-quoted from the roadmap, with 50% of the Audit fee credited toward the build. No hourly rates, no surprises.

**Q: Who do you work with?**
A: Primarily established, profitable SMBs with no internal automation or engineering talent — software-literate service businesses (digital/marketing agencies, e-commerce/DTC brands, recruiting/staffing, professional services, ~10–50 people) and German Mittelstand / industrial companies (manufacturing, mobility/logistics, wholesale/distribution, construction/trades, up to ~300 people). The buyer is usually the owner, managing director, or a Head of Digitalisierung / COO with a modernization mandate. We also help small B2B SaaS teams by warm referral.

**Q: Can I continue development myself after the project?**
A: Yes. Everything belongs to you — full documentation, no vendor lock-in.

**Q: Do you work with clients outside Germany?**
A: Yes. DACH first, then the rest of the EU, UK, and international. English is standard.

**Q: What's the difference between n8n and Make.com?**
A: n8n can be self-hosted (better for GDPR and data-sensitive workflows); Make.com is cloud-only with more pre-built integrations. We're platform-agnostic and recommend whichever fits.

**Q: Is it just one person?**
A: One senior partner (Mahmoud) leads every engagement — no junior hand-off — backed by a vetted specialist network so delivery never stalls.
